title: Sources: Google's AI shakeup is a seismic shift in the works for months and cements Sergey Brin's influence, after execs became frustrated with Demis Hassabis (Financial Times)
commentary: Hassabis built DeepMind into the crown jewel, then watched Brin maneuver him out of the driver's seat. When a co-founder reasserts control over the AI unit mid-race, it's not a vote of confidence — it's a takeover.
